overall: Los Angeles is sitting under a thick marine layer early this morning, with current temps of 64.4°F and a running max of only 66.2°F as of 03:45 ET. High dewpoints (62.6°F, nearly saturating) and persistent fog — consistent with the NWS forecast of patchy fog through mid-morning — indicate a strong onshore flow suppressing overnight and early-morning temperatures. The day is trending cooler than a typical July morning, with zero warming velocity and a slightly negative trend slope suggesting the marine layer has a firm grip.

The NWS official forecast of 75°F aligns with HRRR and falls between the two clusters, but current obs (high dewpoint, fog, cloudy sky) lean supportive of the NBM/lower-model scenario.
